relationships.subject: Axl
relationships.evidence_quote: Axl knockdown exacerbated ROS accumulation in NPCs

key_findings: PPARγ is downregulated in degenerated NPCs and protects against oxidative-stress ferroptosis and ECM degradation via autophagy.
Axl is a novel PPARγ binding partner; PPARγ-Axl signaling via PI3K/AKT delays IVDD in rats, and pioglitazone and AAV-PPARγ were protective.
